## Introduction

In this notebook we do analysis for ICPhS paper on gesture-speech physics in counting-out rhymes

## Detailed explanation of the study and the type of data and variables

Eleven native speakers (three male) of Polish were asked to perform six counting-out rhymes in two different movement conditions and one still condition. The movement conditions involved the counting-out movement with the left or the right hand, and the still condition involved reading the rhyme without any movement. All speakers were right-handed. Additionally, in the movement conditions, speakers were asked to repeat the rhyme with enhanced speed, resulting in another condition. 

Altogether, these sum up to five conditions:

* left hand normal speed
* left hand fast speed
* right hand normal speed
* right hand fast speed
* reading

The order of the blocks was the same for all participants (reading, natural, fast), but the order of counting-out rhymes was randomized as well as whether they began with the dominant or non-dominant hand.

In all of those conditions, the participants performed six counting-out rhymes, the order of which was randomized across participants (cf. rhyme_order.xlsx or columns 6:11 in info.xlsx).

The participants were asked to perform each rhyme with a confederate teddy bear placed in front of them. For each condition, the participants were standing.

## Data wrangling and annotation

We detect outliers using function outlierKD that removes them by Tukey rules on quartiles +/- 1.5 IQR. This code should be run in the console, because the function prompts the user to answer whether they wish to remove the outliers or not.

```{r outliers and synchrony annotation, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

#Function adapted from: http://goo.gl/UUyEzD
# in the form of outlierKD(f0_dec, wrist_f0peak_dec)

outlierKD <- function(dt, var, group = NULL, plot = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) {
  var_chr <- deparse(substitute(var))
  x <- dt[[var_chr]]

  na1     <- sum(is.na(x))
  n_valid <- sum(!is.na(x))
  m1      <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  # flag boxplot outliers (1.5 * IQR rule), optionally within groups
  flag_out <- function(v) {
    out <- boxplot.stats(v)$out
    !is.na(v) & v %in% out
  }
  if (is.null(group)) {
    is_out <- flag_out(x)
  } else {
    is_out <- as.logical(ave(x, dt[[group]], FUN = flag_out))
  }

  x_clean <- x
  x_clean[is_out] <- NA

  if (plot) {
    op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0))
    on.exit(par(op))
    boxplot(x, main = "With outliers")
    hist(x, main = "With outliers", xlab = NA, ylab = NA)
    boxplot(x_clean, main = "Without outliers")
    hist(x_clean, main = "Without outliers", xlab = NA, ylab = NA)
    title(paste("Outlier check:", var_chr), outer = TRUE)
  }

  if (verbose) {
    n_out <- sum(is_out)
    cat("Variable:", var_chr, if (!is.null(group)) paste0("(within ", group, ")"), "\n")
    cat("Outliers identified:", n_out, "\n")
    cat("Proportion (%) of outliers:", round(n_out / n_valid * 100, 1), "\n")
    cat("Mean of the outliers:", if (n_out > 0) round(mean(x[is_out]), 2) else NA, "\n")
    cat("Mean with outliers:", round(m1, 2), "\n")
    cat("Mean without outliers:", round(mean(x_clean, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  }

  dt[[var_chr]] <- x_clean
  invisible(dt)
}
```

We also want to annotate the dataset with synchrony information.
```{r synchrony information, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

### if sync value is negative - kinematic peak leads the acoustic peak
### if sync value is positive - kinematic peak follows the acoustic peak
### if the sync value is between -25 and +25 - acoustic and kinematic peaks are closely synced

## ENV-ACC
df_envacc_sync_w$peak_sync <- NA
df_envacc_sync_w$peak_sync <- ifelse(df_envacc_sync_w$wrist_accenv_sync < -25, 'kpeak leads', ifelse(df_envacc_sync_w$wrist_accenv_sync >= -25 & df_envacc_sync_w$wrist_accenv_sync <= 25, 'closely synced', 'kpeak follows'))

## F0-ACC
df_f0acc_sync_w$peak_sync <- NA
df_f0acc_sync_w$peak_sync <- ifelse(df_f0acc_sync_w$wrist_accf0_sync < -25, 'kpeak leads', ifelse(df_f0acc_sync_w$wrist_accf0_sync >= -25 & df_f0acc_sync_w$wrist_accf0_sync <= 25, 'closely synced', 'kpeak follows'))
```

Here are all four relations in one plot 

```{r kinematics grid plot, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# helper: publication-style plot (as in dec-env), without facetting
pub_plot <- function(data, x, y, xlab, ylab, reverse_x = FALSE, ylims = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = {{ x }} * 100 * 200, y = {{ y }})) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
    geom_smooth(method = loess, formula = y ~ x, color = "black", linetype = "dashed",
                linewidth = 0.4, fill = "gray", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = lm, formula = y ~ x, color = "red", linewidth = 1, fill = "red") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_cowplot(12) +
    theme(title = element_text(size = 10), text = element_text(family = "times"))
  if (reverse_x)        p <- p + scale_x_reverse(labels = abs)
  if (!is.null(ylims))  p <- p + ylim(ylims)
  p
}

# normalize f0 per speaker, same way as the envelope (see note below)
df_f0acc_sync_w$wrist_f0peak_acc_norm <- ave(df_f0acc_sync_w$wrist_f0peak_acc, df_f0acc_sync_w$speaker,
                                             FUN = function(x) scale(x, center = FALSE, scale = TRUE))
df_f0dec_sync_w$wrist_f0peak_dec_norm <- ave(df_f0dec_sync_w$wrist_f0peak_dec, df_f0dec_sync_w$speaker,
                                             FUN = function(x) scale(x, center = FALSE, scale = TRUE))

# the four panels
p_accenv <- pub_plot(df_envacc_sync_w, wrist_apeak, wrist_envpeak_acc_norm,
                     "Acceleration peak, wrist (cm/s^2)", "Amplitude envelope peak (normalized)",
                     ylims = c(0.25, 1.5))

p_accf0  <- pub_plot(df_f0acc_sync_w, wrist_apeak, wrist_f0peak_acc_norm,
                     "Acceleration peak, wrist (cm/s^2)", "F0 peak (normalized)")

p_decenv <- pub_plot(df_envdec_sync_w, wrist_decpeak, wrist_envpeak_dec_norm,
                     "Deceleration peak, wrist (cm/s^2)", "Amplitude envelope peak (normalized)",
                     reverse_x = TRUE, ylims = c(0.25, 1.5))

p_decf0  <- pub_plot(df_f0dec_sync_w, wrist_decpeak, wrist_f0peak_dec_norm,
                     "Deceleration peak, wrist (cm/s^2)", "F0 peak (normalized)",
                     reverse_x = TRUE)

# 2x2 grid with shared y-axis label per column

no_y <- theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

# left column: envelope (A, C)
col_env <- plot_grid(p_accenv + no_y, p_decenv + no_y,
                     ncol = 1, align = "v",
                     labels = c("A", "C"), label_size = 12, label_fontfamily = "times")

# right column: f0 (B, D)
col_f0 <- plot_grid(p_accf0 + no_y, p_decf0 + no_y,
                    ncol = 1, align = "v",
                    labels = c("B", "D"), label_size = 12, label_fontfamily = "times")

# shared y-axis labels
ylab_env <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Amplitude envelope peak (normalized)",
                                  angle = 90, fontfamily = "times", size = 10)
ylab_f0  <- ggdraw() + draw_label("F0 peak (normalized)",
                                  angle = 90, fontfamily = "times", size = 10)

grid_kin <- plot_grid(ylab_env, col_env, ylab_f0, col_f0,
                      nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(0.06, 1, 0.06, 1))

# portrait format
ggsave(file.path(plots, "kinematics_grid.png"), grid_kin, width = 7, height = 9, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(plots, "kinematics_grid.png"), grid_kin, width = 5, height = 7, dpi = 300)

grid_kin
```

This chunk creates plot with example of amplitude envelope, F0 and acceleration time series (first 3.4 seconds from the onset of speech).
There are two plots with acceleration and 1) amplitude envelope, and 2) F0. There are also two smaller zoomed plots that introduce the peaks under study. 
```{r time series plot, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

beauty_colors <- brewer.pal(6, 'Set1') #produce 6 nice diverging colors

######### F0 - ACCELERATION

#let's not have 0 values in the plot, just have gaps of none-voicing
sam$f0 <- ifelse(sam$f0==0, NA, sam$f0)

# let's change unit of acceleration to cm/s^2
sam$a_wrist <- sam$a_wrist*100*200

#for setting the correct ranges to be used as a second axes
  # https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3099219/ggplot-with-2-y-axes-on-each-side-and-different-scales
ylim.f <- range(sam$f0[!is.na(sam$f0)])
ylim.a <- range(sam$a_wrist)  

b <- diff(ylim.f)/diff(ylim.a ) #scaling  factor b of the differences in ranges
a <- ylim.f[1] - b*ylim.a[1]

# plotting

f0acc <- ggplot(sam, aes(x = time_ms)) +
  geom_path(aes(y = f0), color = beauty_colors[1], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_path(aes(y = a+a_wrist*b), color = beauty_colors[2], linewidth = 1.) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 4100, xmax = 4450, ymin = 150, ymax = 400), color = 'black', linetype='dashed', alpha = 0)+ # for dashed-lined area that is zoomed in next plot
  theme_cowplot(12)+ scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1")+ theme(
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = beauty_colors[1]),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = beauty_colors[1]),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = beauty_colors[2]),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = beauty_colors[2]))+
  scale_y_continuous(
    "F0 (Hz)", 
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a)/b, name = "acceleration (cm/s^2)")
  )+ labs(x = '')+
  xlim(2543,6000)+
  theme(title = element_text(size = 10), text = element_text(family = "times"))


####### ENVELOPE - ACCELERATION

#for setting the correct ranges to be used as a second axes
ylim.env <- range(sam$env)
ylim.acc <- range(sam$a_wrist)  

bb <- diff(ylim.env)/diff(ylim.acc ) #scaling  factor b of the differences in ranges
aa <- ylim.env[1] - bb*ylim.acc[1]

## plotting 

envacc <- ggplot(sam, aes(x = time_ms)) +
  geom_path(aes(y = env), color = beauty_colors[3], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_path(aes(y = aa+a_wrist*bb), color = beauty_colors[2], linewidth = 1.) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 4100, xmax = 4450, ymin = 0, ymax = 0.15), color = 'black', linetype='dashed', alpha = 0)+ # for dashed-lined area that is zoomed in next plot
  theme_cowplot(12)+ scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1")+ theme(
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = beauty_colors[3]),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = beauty_colors[3]),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = beauty_colors[2]),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = beauty_colors[2]))+
  scale_y_continuous(
    "amplitude envelope", 
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - aa)/bb, name = "acceleration (cm/s^2)")
  ) + xlab('time (ms)')+
  xlim(2543,6000)+
  theme(title = element_text(size = 10), text = element_text(family = "times"))


## we also create plots for enlarged sections with peaks description

## xintercepts

wenv_peaks_time <- sam_peaks$wrist_envpeak_acc_time
wacc_peaks_time <- sam_peaks$wrist_apeak_time
wdec_peaks_time <- sam_peaks$wrist_decpeak_time
wacc_peaks <- sam_peaks$wrist_apeak
wf0_peaks_time <- sam_peaks$wrist_f0peak_acc_time

## F0-ACC ZOOM
### Note that xintercepts-peaks are multiplied by 100*200 to get acceleration to cm/s^2

f0acc_zoom <- ggplot(sam, aes(x = time_ms)) +
  geom_path(aes(y = f0), color = beauty_colors[1], linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_path(aes(y = a+a_wrist*b), color = beauty_colors[2], linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = wacc_peaks_time, color = beauty_colors[2], linetype = 'solid', linewidth = 1)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = wdec_peaks_time, color = beauty_colors[4], linetype = 'solid', linewidth = 1)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = wf0_peaks_time, color = beauty_colors[1], linetype = 'solid', linewidth = 1)+
  geom_point(data = sam_peaks, aes(x = wrist_apeak_time, y = a+wrist_apeak*b*100*200), color = beauty_colors[2], size = 5) +
  geom_text(data = sam_peaks, aes(x = wrist_apeak_time, y =  a+wrist_apeak*b*100*200, label = 'A'))+
  geom_point(data = sam_peaks, aes(x = wrist_decpeak_time, y = a+wrist_decpeak*b*100*200), color = beauty_colors[4], size = 5) +
  geom_text(data = sam_peaks, aes(x = wrist_decpeak_time, y =  a+wrist_decpeak*b*100*200, label = 'B'))+
  geom_point(data = sam_peaks, aes(x = wrist_f0peak_acc_time , y = wrist_f0peak_acc), color = beauty_colors[1], size = 5) +
  geom_text(data = sam_peaks, aes(x = wrist_f0peak_acc_time, y = wrist_f0peak_acc, label = 'C'))+
  theme_cowplot(12)+ scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_y_continuous(
    "", 
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a)/b, name = "")
  )+ labs(x = '')+
  xlim(4100,4450)

## let's get rid of all legends and axis descriptions

f0acc_z <- f0acc_zoom + 
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.left = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y.left = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank()
  )

## ENV-ACC ZOOM

             widths = c(0.7, 1/3))

# save it 
ggsave(file.path(plots, "timeseries.eps"), plot = timeseries, device = "eps")
```
